raw: Text Maya that I will reach the west entrance around six fifteen and ask her to wait by the ticket machines.
Remind me tomorrow morning to water the balcony herbs and take the blue recycling bin downstairs.
For the grocery list, add rolled oats, two lemons, brown rice, dish soap, and a small bag of coffee.
I think the appointment is probably next Thursday at eleven, but I need to check the card when I get home.
Send the parcel to Nina on Oak Street—sorry, send it to Mina on Pine Street instead.
Write this as two bullet points: bring the folding chairs, and leave the spare key with Daniel.
Jonah paid forty-eight dollars for the repair, and Priya will transfer twenty dollars to him on Friday.
The rain stopped just before lunch, so I walked around Cedar Park and noticed yellow leaves near the pond.

Hi Elena, I finished the library forms and left them in the green folder on your desk. I can meet you after work around seven thirty, although I may be ten minutes late if the bus is crowded. Please save me a seat near the window.

This morning I took the earlier train and found a quiet seat upstairs. The sky was grey near Harbor Station, but it cleared while we crossed the river. I read three chapters, wrote down an idea for the garden shelf, and arrived at the office before nine.
